designNote: Modul Tahun 2 — keperluan DSKP Y2 Language Arts: 'allowing players to build or modify story elements rather than simple rote selection'. Pelajar susun blok cerita ikut turutan logik, BUKAN pilih jawapan tunggal. Guna watak & dunia sama (Kancil, hutan) untuk kesinambungan naratif dengan Modul 6, 7, 9, 10.

instructions.en: Look at the story pictures. Drag them into the correct order — what happens first, next, and last?

feedback.hint: Look for clues: does Kancil look happy or worried in this picture?

panels.captionEn: Kancil is hungry. He sees fruit on the other side of the river.
Kancil asks the crocodiles to line up so he can count them.
Kancil hops across the river on the crocodiles' backs.
Kancil reaches the other side and eats the fruit happily.
A tiger finds Kancil in the forest and wants to eat him.
Kancil points to a cage and says it protects animals from danger.
The curious tiger steps into the cage to see for himself.
Kancil quickly closes the cage and runs away safely.
Kancil is lost and cannot find his way home.
He finds a beehive buzzing loudly on a tree branch.
Kancil politely asks the bees which path leads home.
The bees show him the way, and Kancil walks safely home.
Kancil finds one large fruit but he cannot finish it alone.
He calls his forest friends to come and see.
Kancil cuts the fruit and shares it with everyone.
All the forest friends eat together and feel happy.

scoringLogic.note: PL dikira per storySet (4 panel disusun betul = pencapaian penuh). 4 storySets = 4 percubaan berasingan dalam satu sesi modul.
